channel.title: CrosseRoads Guides
channel.description: Practical guides on career discovery and college admissions, from Dr. Kisa Crosse.

item.title: The 30-Day Career Exploration Challenge
item.description: Your career does not have to be decided today. Your goal is to identify pathways worth exploring — and one focused month is enough to start.

item.title: Junior Year: The Head Start That Makes Senior Year Easy
item.description: The work completed during junior year lays the groundwork for a successful senior year — service, leadership, testing strategy, and a balanced college list.
The three lanes of college money — federal aid, institutional aid, and outside scholarships — and the follow-up habits that keep offers from slipping away.

item.title: The Early Action Advantage: Why Applying Early Can Mean More Offers — and More Money
item.description: Early Action applications often bring earlier decisions, better scholarship consideration, and a far less stressful senior year. Here is how families use them well.

item.title: How to Choose a Career That Fits Who You Are: The 7-Factor Method
item.description: Most people pick careers based on one factor — salary, or a subject they liked. A better fit comes from looking at seven factors together.
